utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, thanks, Sam. I’m glad we’ve got it settled for Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — once you have the date, time, and place, I can help spread the word and check the supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries, Uli — just let me know. I’m still catching up on the details, but I’ll pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. I appreciate you keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Kira — that would really help me. I’m pretty sure it’s Thursday around 7, but I’d love a reminder when we head over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thursday around 7 at the usual place, right? I’ll remind you once you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, that’s right — Thursday around 7 at the usual place. Thanks, Kira, I’d really appreciate the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be there at 7.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, see you then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — see you at 7.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still checking the time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm. We want the book club to feel easy and welcoming for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds great, Jules—no rush at all. Just let me know when you confirm, and I’ll keep things simple for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I’ll confirm the time and let you know soon. I’m glad we’re keeping it simple and welcoming for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — just let me know what you need for the next meeting, and I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — could you send me the date, time, and place for the next meeting? Once I have that, I can let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll send over the date, time, and place for the next meeting right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing—I’ll check the supplies and let you know if we need anything for the next book club meeting.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—can you confirm whether Thursday at 7 still works for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check with everyone and see if Thursday at 7 still works.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got Thursday at 7 at your place noted down. If the address changes, just let me know and I’ll update it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, Thursday at 7 works for me — I’ll let you know right away if the address changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks — I’ll keep Thursday at 7 on my notes, and just send me the address if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks. Let me know what the book club says.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep you posted on who’s interested.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — appreciate it. I’ll wait to hear what the book club thinks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help pick this month’s book and send a quick reminder to the group. Any genre or reading length you want?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — I’d love something light or feel-good, and not too long since I’ll be juggling school pickup. Also, a 7 o’clock meeting still sounds best if that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works for me — I’ll look for a light, feel-good pick that’s on the shorter side and send out a reminder for 7 o’clock.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, I’ll probably be a little late again, but I’ll save you a seat near me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’d appreciate that. What time do you think you’ll get there?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Probably around 7:30, if everything goes smoothly. I’ll text you if I’m running behind.
